finding: FIRST FRONTIER-MODEL LIFT: both frontier-closed models are individually significant on isotope half-lives (claude net +7 p=0.016, gpt-5.5 net +8 p=0.021) — unlike constants (near-ceiling, n.s.) and materials formula (frontier n.s., no headroom). Isotope half-lives carry genuine long-tail error mass even for frontier models, so the lift reaches them. This confirms the axis is headroom x detection recall, NOT model tier: give a frontier model a domain where it errs on the long tail and is extractable, and gated correction lifts it significantly.
